observation: I watched a hotel manager in Muscat resolve a staff conflict in under three minutes. He didn't mediate. He didn't lecture. He asked one question: "What would you do if this were your hotel?" Both employees answered — and in answering, solved it themselves. I've used that single question in boardrooms worth a hundred times that hotel's revenue. The technique scales. The principle doesn't change.
context: Observation from 15 years of cross-industry consulting
